column1: # Vendored zlib-1.0.4 function labels. The sources under vendor/ are PRISTINE
# (no rva.h macros), so this table is the claim channel for their TUs: labels.py
# emits each row into the unit's symbol_names fragment, authority-checked against
# the base obj. size is the retail code extent (the vendored TUs are byte-matched,
# so their claims carry the exact size, like RVA(rva, size) does for game code).
